sentences.en: The alert officer perceived a dim shape in the distance.
sentences.zh: 警觉的军官在远处察觉到一个模糊的身影。

sentences.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我在机场被海关官员搜身。

sentences.en: He suddenly took a defiant attitude toward the police officer.
sentences.zh: 他突然对警察的态度变得挑衅起来。

senses.zh: 军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长
